notes.title: Update notes for July 15th, 2025 (Version 1.01, Bugfix Update)
notes.content:
[p]A small patch to clean up a few bugs, make the visuals more consistent, and make some minor balance adjustments.
   [/p][p][/p][p]Balance tweaks [/p][list][*][p]Reduced HP of [i]Ghoul[/i] (16 -> 15)[/p][/*][*][p]Altered decks for tournament players (New decks added: Light Control, Blazing Dragon Maidens, Warrior Bloodlust. Ultimate Phoenix deck for Loveless made weaker)
[/p][/*][/list][p]Other fixes  [/p][list][*][p]Fixed 'Best Pet Survey' crash bug (occured when None-type monster won the survey, gave out bugged None type tickets) [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed visual errors (incorrect card display for Office Cup prize card, red gameboard with purple background)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed play/discard requirements for [i]Child Prince[/i], [i]Angel of Taboo[/i], and [i]Fallen Angel[/i] [/p][/*][*][p]Minor dialogue tweaks [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where middle mouse button disabled menu UI [/p][p][/p][/*][/list]

tags.feature: Altered decks for tournament players (New decks added: Light Control, Blazing Dragon Maidens, Warrior Bloodlust. Ultimate Phoenix deck for Loveless made weaker)

tags.bug: Fixed 'Best Pet Survey' crash bug (occured when None-type monster won the survey, gave out bugged None type tickets)
Fixed visual errors (incorrect card display for Office Cup prize card, red gameboard with purple background)
Fixed play/discard requirements for Childs Prince, Angel of Taboo, and Fallen Angel
Fixed issue where middle mouse button disabled menu UI
